quests.title: Before They Touch Gunnamatta Bay
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. They start on Gunnamatta Bay on Monday and the orange fencing goes up. This is the third time I have had this conversation. I want Cronulla on record before it does. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

then the other end of it

quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Bundeena ferry
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The site at the Bundeena ferry starts its jackhammer at the arvo on a Friday, which is illegal and loud. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Photograph it running and have a word with the Cronulla foreman. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: The Kingsway Tab
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. Two chippies off the Kingsway job have run a tab in Cronulla since Australia Day. It started small, the way these things do. They drove past at the last train without looking in, so settle it in cash. That's the whole job. No catch.

and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: Trouble at Cronulla Mall
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Two lads and their mate decided at ten past ten that Cronulla Mall is theirs. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. The rest of Cronulla disagrees, so explain the disagreement. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: sort the pair near Cronulla Mall
and the mate who joined in

quests.title: Staffy Near North Cronulla
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at North Cronulla at midnight. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Everyone in Cronulla has definitely seen it and can't say where. That's it. That's the whole ask.

tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: Race Four, North Cronulla

quests.title: Left It Near the Alley
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I left something on the bench at the Alley at half two. You will see what I mean the second you get there. By the time I got back to Cronulla it had walked, so look where I'd have dropped it. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.
